run_local_benchmark: run a local benchmark by creating a LocalBench instance and calling run with debug flag
initialize_local_bench: create a LocalBench instance with bench and node parameter dictionaries to configure the testbed
background_run_command: run a shell command in a background tmux session with output redirected to a log file
kill_testbed_nodes: kill all running testbed nodes and processes using the kill command from CommandMaker
review_local_bench_run: review the LocalBench run method to understand how clients, primaries, and workers are orchestrated
